Produce Telugu script and romanisation.
Integrated Telugu offline lab: read, transform in Telugu script, and rehearse aloud. Check Telugu agglutinative suffixes, case marking, agreement, and respectful forms.

lessons.srs_policy: Only selected high-value forms are preselected; actual mistakes and productive patterns enter personalized review after learner evidence.
